title: dispatch_hardware_aware_job
description: Profile a task and dispatch it asynchronously to the most efficient hardware backend (LPU/GPU/SSM/Wasm-local) via deterministic policy routing. Returns a job_id and the assigned hardware profile immediately (fire-and-forget). Feature A: Heterogeneous Hardware Dispatcher.

task_description.description: Natural-language description of the task. Used by the deterministic profiler to detect mechanical/deterministic edits.

context_size_estimate.description: Estimated context/token footprint. >= 32768 routes to SSM (linear context scaling); <= 8192 is eligible for LPU realtime routing.

latency_requirement.description: Latency intent. 'realtime' biases toward ultra-low-latency LPU backends; 'batch' permits denser/cheaper backends.

workload_tags.description: Optional caller-supplied workload tags merged with profiler-derived tags for policy matching.

target_workspace_uuid.description: Optional shadow workspace the dispatched job should operate against.

hardware_target_hint.description: Advisory hint only. Server policy makes the authoritative routing decision; callers cannot force an unsafe backend.

quality_floor.description: Optional minimum acceptable quality score; used by policy guardrails when assist paths are enabled.
